note: Shoshone NF campground beside Fiddlers Lake in the Wind River Range, 12 miles south on Forest Road 300 (the Loop Road) from WY-131 south of Lander. Sites sit in the pines along the west shore. Trails lead into the Popo Agie Wilderness and south to other lakes; the nearby Christina Lake trailhead has horse corrals. --Claude
